harnessArtifacts.name: Screenshot CSP warning
harnessArtifacts.evidence: Playwright 1.62.1 coreBundle.js inPagePrepareForScreenshots temporarily appends <style>body {}</style> when WebKit shouldToggleStyleSheetToSyncAnimations is true. Strict shipped style-src correctly rejects this. Exactly one warning appeared per screenshot, zero before screenshots. Setting caret: initial did not remove this animation-sync injection. Screenshot-free final runtime reports zero console/JS/GL/request errors.
harnessArtifacts.resolution: Kept raw warnings in original reports. No CSP weakening or game code change was made for the harness.

harnessArtifacts.name: First paused-clock title capture black
harnessArtifacts.evidence: Initial full-title.png captured before compositor presentation under a paused Playwright clock. Real-time fresh session waited for multiple rendered frames and produced visual-title-real-clock.png with full world scene.
harnessArtifacts.resolution: Use the real-time image for title visual QA.

harnessArtifacts.name: Discarded mixed-clock route attempt
harnessArtifacts.evidence: visual-followup.cjs installed fake clock after requestAnimationFrame was already registered in real time, so that attempted route did not advance.
harnessArtifacts.resolution: Only its real-time title and genuine start tap are used as evidence. All route evidence is from full-game-qa.cjs and delta-checks.cjs, which install their clock before navigation.
